summary: Recovered the preserved external operator callback subscription foundation onto the current post-merge-fixes base. The implementation adds durable callback subscriptions and deliveries, POST/GET /v1/callbacks, idempotent registration and enqueue semantics, sanitized workspace/operation/merge envelopes, disabled-subscription skipping, retry/failure handling, and a callback migration chained after Alembic head 7b8c9d0e1f2a. The remaining conformance gap is closed: callback subscription event_types now allow only workspace.*, merge.*, operation.*, or exact public callback event type names, and reject internal-looking namespaced values such as workspace.internal_secret, merge.internal_secret, and operation.internal_secret. Wildcard matching uses the same public allowlist so internal source event names are not delivered. Validation passed: focused callback API/service/db tests, Alembic head and migration graph tests, compatibility tests for events/operations/merge queue, ruff, mypy, full unit suite, workspace profile validation commands, and full coverage at 99.01%.
